purpose: Automatic cost/token/coverage/generation-validity/lineage accounting for the EvoEmo Raw Session Top-4 / All Raw Sessions secondary tables. This is the response.automatic_scope portion of the existing v5_2_external_e5_scoring_v1 contract (token/cost, routing/coverage, policy alias, baseline call accounting) applied to response_raw_outcomes_private.jsonl, which the frozen 28f_score_v5_2_external_e5_v1_5.py implementation never reads. It does not replace, rescore, or reopen v5_2_external_e5_scoring_v1; that contract and its metric_freeze.json/scoring outputs remain sealed and unmodified.

in_scope: verify original raw call plan count (552) against actual valid outcomes (551) and the registered invalid generation (1)
apply the already-frozen whole-state exclusion (registered_invalid_generation.json.raw_secondary_table_excluded_call_ids) to remove the excluded state from both raw conditions symmetrically

report, per condition (raw_session_top4_plus_frozen_strategy, all_raw_sessions_plus_frozen_strategy): state count, call count, prompt/completion/total tokens (sum and mean), proxy USD cost, physical generation validity relative to the original per-condition plan, retrieval/session coverage (candidate_session_count, selected_before/after_context_fit) inherited from E3
record explicit exclusion rationale and the excluded state_id/call_ids
out_of_scope_forbidden: any lexical, embedding, or LLM-based proxy for open-ended response quality
any grounding/interaction risk inference from raw response text
modifying, rescoring, or re-freezing v5_2_external_e5_scoring_v1 or its metric_freeze.json
modifying PM, retriever, generator, Strategy Bank, prompt, seed, or external data
reading response_or_outcome content for anything other than token/finish-reason/fallback/guard-error bookkeeping fields already present in the outcome rows

whole_state_exclusion.reason: deterministic_single_request_repetition_degeneration, independently confirmed at output-token caps 300 and 512; permanently registered invalid rather than retried, imputed, or adopted truncated (V15-ENG-22/23)
whole_state_exclusion.why_whole_state_not_just_the_one_call: Raw Top-4 and All Raw must remain a fair paired comparison unit over the same state set; dropping only the failed call would leave this state present in one raw condition but not the other.
